# Exact versions this project was developed and evaluated with (Python 3.11).
# Every third-party import in this archive is listed; the list was generated by
# walking the AST of every shipped .py, not written by hand.

# --- core model / training ---
torch==2.7.1                  # +cu118 build used here
torchvision==0.22.1
lightning==2.1.2
torchmetrics==1.0.1           # base class for every metric in rawdiffusion/evaluation
hydra-core==1.3.2
omegaconf==2.3.0
numpy==1.26.4
PyYAML==6.0.3                  # every metric writes its result as yaml
scipy==1.17.1
tqdm==4.65.0                  # the DDIM/DDPM sampling loops
torchinfo==1.8.0              # train.py's model summary
rich==13.8.1                  # sample.py progress output
aim==3.17.5                   # experiment logging in train.py

# --- image and array I/O ---
tifffile==2026.3.3            # float32 linear predictions
Pillow==12.1.1
imageio==2.35.1
h5py==3.12.1                  # sample.py, optional hdf5 prediction dump
scikit-image==0.26.0          # sample.py
opencv-python-headless==4.8.0.74
# ^ MUST be a build with the OpenEXR backend, or .exr reads return None.
#   Verify:  python -c "import cv2;print('openexr' in cv2.getBuildInformation().lower())"
#   and export OPENCV_IO_ENABLE_OPENEXR=1 before the process starts.

# --- metrics ---
lpips==0.1.4
piq==0.8.0                    # PU21-VSI, SSIM, MS-SSIM
torch-fidelity==0.4.0         # FID; supplies the canonical Inception weights
pyiqa==0.1.16                 # reference PU21-PIQE

# --- notes ---
# pyiqa is NOT installed in the environment that produced the paper's numbers;
# it was installed to an isolated --target directory and put on PYTHONPATH only
# for the PIQE cells, to avoid disturbing a shared environment with live jobs.
#
# HDR-VDP-3 is not a Python package. metrics/hdrvdp3_bridge.py drives the
# official MATLAB/Octave release 3.0.7 out of process; install it separately and
# point $VDP_ROOT at it. Octave must be on PATH.
